announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.6.0
announcement.content:
Choose what each relationship shares across PCs.

  • Open Manage sharing, choose Character profile, Shared details or Shared party progress, then adjust any of the 19 fields. Hover over a checkbox or focus it with the keyboard for an explanation.
  • Character profile shares the contact's role, bio, stat cards, portraits, map artwork, cut-in images and accent color. Each PC can keep their own relationship type and rank.
  • Starting to share a field copies its value from the open relationship. Turning sharing off keeps the last shared value for each PC to edit independently.
  • After a GM applies the sharing settings, players with editing permission can update unshared fields, including notes and events, while the GM is offline. An owner of the PC must be connected.
